name: Dearborn
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Dearborn for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events. The magic runs from November 26 (The Polar Express 3D at the Giant Screen Experience) through January 3 (Light and Joy in the Holiday Season), with Visits with Santa at The Henry Ford (November 27 to December 6), the Christmas Open House at the Dearborn Historical Museum (December 5), Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village (December 3 to 28) and the free Jingle Bell Bash (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Dearborn

  • 8 Christmas events for Dearborn families
  • Free: the Downtown Dearborn Jingle Bell Bash on December 12
  • Meet Santa: Visits with Santa at The Henry Ford, Supper with Santa in Greenfield Village, and the Dearborn Historical Museum open house on December 5
  • Trains and movies: The Polar Express 3D, daily through January 1, and Greenfield Village Holiday Nights
  • Lights: Light and Joy in the Holiday Season at the Henry Ford Museum, through January 3
  • Season: November 26, 2026 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Dearborn families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Symphony, Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit, Noel Night and Wayne County LightFest.
